targets.rawSql: SELECT k.skill AS "Skill", COUNT(DISTINCT k.session_id) AS "Sessions" FROM session_skills k JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=k.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT m.model AS "Model", SUM(m.input_tokens+m.output_tokens+m.cache_read_tokens+m.cache_write_tokens+m.reasoning_tokens) AS "Tokens" FROM session_models m JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=m.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', s.start_time) AS time, k.skill AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT k.session_id) AS value FROM session_skills k JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=k.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.model AS "Model", COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions", SUM(m.requests) AS "Requests", SUM(m.input_tokens) AS "Input", SUM(m.output_tokens) AS "Output", SUM(m.cache_read_tokens) AS "Cache Read", SUM(m.reasoning_tokens) AS "Reasoning", SUM(m.cost) AS "Premium Cost" FROM session_models m JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=m.session_id WHERE s.complete AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT k.skill AS "Skill", COUNT(DISTINCT k.session_id) AS "Sessions", SUM(k.invocations) AS "Invocations" FROM session_skills k JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=k.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
